learning.title: A fresh worktree needs an install and a Storybook build before the rails and story checks
learning.trigger: pnpm test:rails or pnpm ui:stories:check fails in a new worktree on a missing packages/ui/storybook-static/index.json.
learning.mistake: Reported the rails suite as blocked by a pre-existing missing fixture instead of building the artifact the worktree lacks.
learning.rule: A fresh worktree has no installed dependencies and no built artifacts. packages/ui/storybook-static is gitignored, and tests/rails/ui-foundations_test.ts and scripts/verify-ui-stories.ts read its index.json. Run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile and pnpm --dir packages/ui build-storybook once per worktree before them, and rebuild after a story or component change so the index is not stale.

verification.requirement: Record the exit codes. A missing storybook-static index is an unbuilt artifact, not an environment blocker; see local-services-before-test-blocker.
